SELECT C.*, , , ,
FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_CONTENT WETC ON WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WETC.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WEA ON WEA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WETC.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON WETC.CONTENT_ID = C.CONTENT_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT_ASSOC CA ON CA.CONTENT_ID_TO = C.CONTENT_ID AND CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'REP_PERM' INNER JOIN DATA_RESOURCE DR ON DR.DATA_RESOURCE_ID = C.DATA_RESOURCE_ID WHERE CA.CONTENT_ID = 'WE_PRINT' AND WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID = #{parentTypeId} AND WETC.IS_VISIBLE = 'Y'
AND WETC.ONLY_ADMIN = 'N'
ORDER BY WETC.SEQUENCE_NUM ASC

SELECT C.*, , , ,
FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_CONTENT WETC ON WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WETC.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WEA ON WEA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WETC.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON WETC.CONTENT_ID = C.CONTENT_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT_ASSOC CA ON CA.CONTENT_ID_TO = C.CONTENT_ID AND CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'REP_PERM' INNER JOIN DATA_RESOURCE DR ON DR.DATA_RESOURCE_ID = C.DATA_RESOURCE_ID WHERE CA.CONTENT_ID = 'WE_PRINT' AND WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = #{workEffortTypeId} ORDER BY WETC.SEQUENCE_NUM ASC

SELECT C.*, ,
FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WEA ON WEA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON WEA.REPORT_ID = C.CONTENT_ID WHERE WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID = #{parentTypeId}

SELECT C.*, ,
FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WEA ON WEA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON WEA.REPORT_ID = C.CONTENT_ID WHERE WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID = #{parentTypeId} AND C.CONTENT_ID = #{reportContentId}

SELECT C.DESCRIPTION, C.MIME_TYPE_ID FROM CONTENT_ASSOC CA INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID WHERE CA.CONTENT_ID_TO = #{reportContentId} AND CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'TYPE_PRINT' ORDER BY CA.SEQUENCE_NUM ASC

SELECT WEA.* FROM WORK_EFFORT_ASSOC WEA INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT WETO ON WETO.WORK_EFFORT_ID = WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ID_TO INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WETTO ON WETTO.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WETO.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT WEFROM ON WEFROM.WORK_EFFORT_ID = WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ID_FROM INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WETFROM ON WETFROM.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WEFROM.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID WHERE WETFROM.PARENT_TYPE_ID = WETTO.PARENT_TYPE_ID AND WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ID_TO = #{workEffortId} AND WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID != 'SNAPSHOT' AND WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID != 'COPY' AND WEA.WORK_EFFORT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID != 'TEMPL'
